2034-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

3951-4247-4875-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4247-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

728-6972-7768.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2071-2348-4019--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Cast Wolfwillow Haven by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the land creature.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Wolfwillow Haven triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2071-2348-4019--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

3132-3259-6791.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

129-955-1409-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

5088-5211-5686-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
5088-5211-5686-7443-7537.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate two of those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, activate your remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least six mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Activate Shilengar by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, creating a Blood token.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Brass's Bounty with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Shilengar by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, creating a Blood token.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 19.

2034-3490-3641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-3641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3490-4050-5789-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-5789-6996.description:
Gain life.

When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

141-6709-7302.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
141-6709-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or command zone by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable, reduced by Ballad of the Black Flag.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
Repeat from step 3.

2919-4659-4772-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4659-4772-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

3532-5078-6709-6822.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-6709-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

640-5010-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2228-3108-3734.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Phyrexian Metamorph.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Metamorph by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2445-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Branching Evolution.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

573-4572-4826-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-4572-4826-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2092-3455-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Vizier of Many Faces and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3455-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Vizier of Many Faces and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Vizier of Many Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Vizier of Many Faces to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Vizier of Many Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

575-897-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

578-1812-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-1812-3525.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least two artifact cards from your hand and add at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

2034-2493-2596-5284.notablePrerequisites:
Blood Vassal does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
2034-2493-2596-5284.description:
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards in their graveyards, sacrifice all creatures they control, then put all cards exiled this way onto the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

430-1061-3285.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Goblin Assault triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate any Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

157-804-5299.description:
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Detention Sphere that is a 3/3 legendary enchantment creature named Sakishima the Imposter.
When Sakashima the Impostor, it triggers its first ability from Detention Sphere, exiling itself.
Sakashima the Impostor leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability from Detention Sphere, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of Detention Sphere that is a 3/3 legendary creature named Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
End the loop by choosing a different creature to copy or a different permanent to exile, or by declining to exile anything.

3422-3587.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
You have a way to deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
3422-3587.description:
Give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
Cast Boros Charm by paying {R}{W}, giving permanents you control indestructible until end of turn.
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing that much damage to itself and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 4 any number of times.
